We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target molecule: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have a template (id 29646) that deprotects TBS? Actually retro template: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2]-[C:2] meaning forward is protection: alcohol + TBSCl -> TBS ether. Retro: remove TBS to give alcohol. So applying to target gave three possible precursors (with TBS groups). The results show three SMILES: each with a TBS group attached to some OH. Let's examine them.

Result list: 
1: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'
2: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'
3: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'

These are same core with TBS on different OH: either on carboxylic acid OH? Actually O[Si] attached to the terminal carboxylic acid? The first has O[Si] attached to the acid O (C(=O)O[Si]...). second has O[Si] attached to the primary alcohol side chain CO? third has O[Si] attached to the secondary alcohol on the ring.

We need 5 steps total. Likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS (reverse of protection) to get free OH. 2) Use Still-Gennari/HWE to form the conjugated diene chain from aldehyde/ester. 3) DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde. 4) Protect alcohols with TBS. 5) maybe start from simple building blocks like cyclohexanol derivative and a side chain.

We need to construct route using available templates. We have template for TBS protection (retro). Also need template for Still-Gennari (retro would be cleavage of double bond to give aldehyde and phosphonate). Need to search for templates that break C=C and form aldehyde etc.

Search for functional_groups_broken ["C-C double bonds"] formed ["aldehydes"] maybe.
